```{r setup, include=FALSE }
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(sandwich)
library(lmtest)
library(patchwork)
library(MASS)
library(brms)
```


```{r}
set.seed(1)
T_len <- 400; K <- 100

# parameters
s    <- 0.30   # share of output reinvested
dep  <- 0.03   # depreciation
rN   <- 0.25   # population growth rate
dbase <- 0.02  # baseline mortality
kappa <- 1.2   # mortality response to capital loss
om   <- 2      # lag for measuring capital loss
mu   <- 0.04   # aspirant growth from surplus
aeps <- 0.02   # aspirant natural decay
W    <- 6      # number of elite positions
thr  <- 0.6    # collapse trigger: (A - W)/W > thr
f    <- 0.4    # share of capital destroyed in a purge
g    <- 0.5    # share of aspirants removed in a purge

a1 <- 0.5      # share of non-automatable labor 
a2 <- 0.5      # share of automatable labor
alpha <- 0.3   # share of the capital in the income
w0 <- 15
k <- 0.5
psi_max <- 100
nu <- 20
w_min <- 5

N <- C <- A <- w <- theta <- Z <- hit <- rep(NA, T_len) # initialization
N[1] <- 40
C[1] <- 40
A[1] <- 2
theta[1] <- 0.8
Z[1] <- 10

```

```{r}
N_test <- seq(40, by = 2, length.out = T_len)   # population 
C_test <- seq(30, by = 3, length.out = T_len)   # capital 
theta_test <- seq(1, by = 0.5, length.out = T_len)   # automation
Z_test <- seq(1, by = 0.5, length.out = T_len)      # time varying technology parameter
```


```{r}
func_labor_supply <- function(w, w0, k, psi_max, N) {
  share <- psi_max / ( 1 + exp(-k*(w - w0)) )
  share * N
}

func_labor_demand <- function(alpha, theta, Z, C, w) {
  ld1 <- (((1-alpha)*theta*Z*C^alpha)/w)^(1/alpha)
  ld2 <- 1/(a1+theta*a2)
  ld1 * ld2
}

```

```{r}
solve_w <- function(w, w0, k, psi_max, N, nu, alpha, theta, Z, C) {
  func_labor_demand(alpha, theta, Z, C, w) - func_labor_supply(w, w0, k, psi_max, N)
}

w_sol <- w <- rep(NA, T_len)
for (t in (nu+2):T_len){
  N_lag <- N_test[t-nu] ; C_prev <- C_test[t-1] ; theta1 <- theta_test[t] ; Z1 <- Z_test[t] 
  w_sol[t] <- uniroot(solve_w, lower = w_min, upper = 1000, 
               w0 = w0, k = k, psi_max = psi_max, N = N_lag, nu = nu, alpha = alpha, theta = theta1, Z = Z1, C = C_prev)$root
  w[t] <- max(w_sol[t] , w_min) # after floor
}
data.frame(t = 1:T_len, w_sol, w)
```


```{r}
for (t in 2:T) {

  Y   <- C[t-1]^0.5 * N[t-1]^0.5          # output
  #Y <- Z[t-1] * C[t-1]^alpha * Ld[t-1]^(1-alpha)
  
  rho <- s * Y                             # surplus
  #rho <- Y + w*Ld
  
  C[t] <- C[t-1] + rho - dep * C[t-1]                  # capital accumulates
  A[t] <- A[t-1] + mu * rho * (N[t-1] / K) - aeps * A[t-1]  # aspirants grow

  if ((A[t] - W) / W > thr) {              # elite-conflict trigger -> purge
    C[t]  <- C[t] * (1 - f)
    A[t]  <- A[t] * (1 - g)
    hit[t] <- 1
  }

  loss <- max(1 - C[t] / C[max(t - om, 1)], 0)   # recent capital loss
  d    <- min(dbase + kappa * loss, 0.9)         # mortality
  N[t] <- max(N[t-1] + rN * N[t-1] * (1 - N[t-1] / K) - d * N[t-1], 1)
}

ev <- which(hit == 1)
print(ev); print(diff(ev))                 # collapse times and cycle length

par(mfrow = c(3, 1), mar = c(3, 4, 2, 1))
plot(N, type = "l", main = "Population N"); abline(v = ev, col = "grey80")
plot(C, type = "l", main = "Capital C");    abline(v = ev, col = "grey80")
plot(A, type = "l", main = "Aspirants A")
abline(h = W * (1 + thr), col = "red", lty = 2); abline(v = ev, col = "grey80")
```
